shot.derivation: Right half of the diptych. Flat white sky, no cast shadow: overcast. Eye at about 1.6 m on the lawn with the horizon low in the frame and the crown centre about 14 m up at 45 m: the eye sits about 15 degrees below the aim. The crown touches the top edge and the base sits near the bottom: fill 0.93. Trunk clear for about a tenth of the height.
